set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED_HEAD=d5ea880f00048ea7b6c12ea2b4d54e8f2dca8026; EXPECTED_FIRMWARE=0cbd181f46661423d1983ad1805f11d6fecc5128; PORT=/dev/cu.usbserial-1130; git fetch --quiet origin mvp/environment-controller; REMOTE_SHA=$(git rev-parse origin/mvp/environment-controller); echo "EXPECTED_HEAD=$EXPECTED_HEAD"; echo "REMOTE_SHA=$REMOTE_SHA"; test "$REMOTE_SHA" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"; git reset --hard "$EXPECTED_HEAD"; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; OUT=/tmp/stage27c-flash-to-sd-recovery-20260903-v1; rm -rf "$OUT"; .venv/bin/python tools/stage27c_soak.py --port "$PORT" --output-dir "$OUT" --duration 180 --progress-seconds 30 --expected-sha "$EXPECTED_FIRMWARE" --strict; echo STAGE27C_FLASH_TO_SD_RECOVERY_SUMMARY; cat "$OUT/summary.json"; .venv/bin/python - "$OUT/soak.ndjson" <<'PY'
import json, sys
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8') if line.strip()]
assert len(rows) >= 15, f'too few soak rows: {len(rows)}'
assert all(r.get('firmware_sha') == '0cbd181f46661423d1983ad1805f11d6fecc5128' for r in rows), 'unexpected firmware identity'
backends=[r.get('storage_backend') for r in rows]
assert set(backends).issubset({'flash','sd'}), backends
assert 'sd' in backends, f'SD recovery not observed: {backends}'
first_sd=backends.index('sd')
assert all(b == 'sd' for b in backends[first_sd:]), f'backend unstable after SD recovery: {backends}'
assert all(int(r.get('storage_sd_mounted', 0)) == 1 for r in rows[first_sd:]), 'SD not continuously mounted after recovery'
assert all(int(r.get('storage_flash_mounted', 0)) == 0 for r in rows[first_sd:]), 'flash remained mounted after SD recovery'
recoveries=[int(r.get('storage_sd_recoveries', 0)) for r in rows]
assert max(recoveries) >= 1, f'sd_recoveries did not increment: {recoveries}'
fallbacks=[int(r.get('storage_fallbacks', 0)) for r in rows]
assert max(fallbacks) >= 1, f'prior flash fallback not retained: {fallbacks}'
assert max(int(r.get('storage_write_errors', 0)) for r in rows) == 0, 'storage write errors observed'
assert max(int(r.get('storage_queue_drops', 0)) for r in rows) == 0, 'storage queue drops observed'
assert max(int(r.get('storage_records_skipped', 0)) for r in rows) == 0, 'storage records skipped observed'
mount_errors=[int(r.get('storage_sd_mount_errors', 0)) for r in rows]
assert len(set(mount_errors[first_sd:])) == 1, f'SD mount errors increased after recovery: {mount_errors}'
written=[int(r.get('storage_records_written', 0)) for r in rows]
assert written[-1] - written[0] >= 3, f'records did not advance after recovery: {written}'
print('STAGE27C_FLASH_TO_SD_RECOVERY_OK', {'rows':len(rows),'first_sd_index':first_sd,'backends':backends[:min(len(backends),8)],'sd_recoveries':max(recoveries),'fallbacks':max(fallbacks),'records_written_first':written[0],'records_written_last':written[-1],'sd_mount_errors':mount_errors[-1]})
PY
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
